# T-5: Enforce round choices

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Limit automatic acceptance-review repair rounds and present user-decision behavior at the round limit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Round 1 non-pass automatically returns to the target step.
- Round 2 non-pass stops automatic routing and exposes user choices.
- Risk acceptance is rejected when mechanicalBlockers is non-empty.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse existing acceptance decision surfaces when their schema can represent the round-limit choices; extend the schema only for missing required choices.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests under specs/293-bounded-defer-review/tests/ with // spec: R7 headers cover round counting, reset range, user choice generation, and mechanical-blocker risk rejection.
